root_cause.text: In gpio_mpsse_probe(), a USB device reference obtained via usb_get_dev() is not released on error paths, causing a reference leak when probe fails after the call.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "The reference obtained by calling usb_get_dev() is not released in the gpio_mpsse_probe() error paths." The patch adds a device-managed cleanup (devm_add_action_or_reset) to automatically call usb_put_dev() on probe failure or device removal, and removes the manual usb_put_dev() in the disconnect function.

Author: Mary Strodl <mstrodl@csh.rit.edu>

bic_trace_step.reason: In gpio_mpsse_probe(), line `priv->udev = usb_get_dev(interface_to_usbdev(interface));` acquires a USB device reference. However, on multiple error paths (e.g., after ida_simple_get failure, devm_add_action_or_reset failure, devm_kasprintf failure, usb_find_common_endpoints failure, devm_kmalloc failure, and usb_control_msg failures), the function returns without calling usb_put_dev(priv->udev). No cleanup mechanism exists in this commit to release the reference on probe failure, leading to a reference leak. The disconnect function (gpio_mpsse_disconnect) does release the reference, but it is only reached if probe succeeds, so the fix is absent.

bic_trace_step.reason: In gpio_mpsse_probe(), line 'priv->udev = usb_get_dev(interface_to_usbdev(interface));' takes a USB device reference. However, on subsequent error paths (e.g., when ida_simple_get fails, devm_add_action_or_reset fails, devm_kasprintf fails, usb_find_common_endpoints fails, devm_kmalloc fails, usb_control_msg fails, or devm_gpiochip_add_data fails), the function returns directly without calling usb_put_dev(priv->udev) or any other mechanism to release the reference. The only usb_put_dev appears in gpio_mpsse_disconnect(), which is not called on probe failure. This causes a reference leak on all probe failure paths after the usb_get_dev() call.
